_comment: EMULATOR-ONLY Firebase config. These are not real credentials and grant
access to nothing — a project id starting with 'demo-' makes the Firebase
emulator suite refuse to contact production, so the SDK never leaves your
This exists so you can run the whole app end to end with no cloud project
at all: ./scripts/dev_emulator.sh copies it into place and launches the
app against the local Auth + Firestore emulators.
Never ship a build made with this file.
